_field_guidance.notes: artifact_sha256 and artifact_byte_length must describe the exact raw bytes placed under raw/. retrieval_time and export_time are distinct from the bars' event times. Only CSV is normalized this batch.
_field_guidance.purpose: Declares provenance and semantics for one raw export. Replace every <REPLACE: ...> value, then delete this _field_guidance block before running preflight.

artifact_byte_length: <REPLACE: integer byte length of the exact raw file>
artifact_sha256: <REPLACE: 64-hex lowercase SHA-256 of the exact raw file>
canonical_symbol: <REPLACE: your canonical symbol for this instrument>
event_timezone: <REPLACE: UTC, an explicit offset like -05:00, or an IANA zone>
expected_end_time: <REPLACE: ISO-8601 UTC end of declared coverage>
expected_start_time: <REPLACE: ISO-8601 UTC start of declared coverage>
export_time: <REPLACE: ISO-8601 UTC instant the provider produced it, e.g. 2026-01-16T09:45:00Z>
price_adjustment_semantics: <REPLACE: one of RAW_UNADJUSTED, SPLIT_ADJUSTED, SPLIT_AND_DIVIDEND_ADJUSTED, UNKNOWN>
provider_symbol: <REPLACE: symbol exactly as the provider labels it>
retrieval_time: <REPLACE: ISO-8601 UTC instant you retrieved it, e.g. 2026-01-16T10:00:00Z>
session_coverage: <REPLACE: one of PREMARKET, REGULAR, AFTER_HOURS, OVERNIGHT, EXTENDED, CLOSED_SESSION, UNKNOWN>
timestamp_semantics: <REPLACE: one of START, END, LABEL, UNKNOWN>
user_entitlement_assertion: <REPLACE: state that you are entitled to use this export under its terms>
